title: cfrp-strengthening
description:
This repository turns the ACI 440.2R design checks for externally bonded FRP strengthening into small public calculations that anyone can re-run from the inputs alone.

Status: active. One recorded result, labelled VERIFIED for ten printed quantities, is that the checker reproduces the Simpson Strong-Tie worked example. The strengthened design strength, 481.7 kip-ft against a demand of 457.8 kip-ft, is checker output, and the result does not claim serviceability.
